analytic.limitations: Known horizontal carriers are an artificial task; false-band/peak metrics quantify residual energy, not a complete hallucination detector. GPU FP16 results are not exact replay of earlier CPU FP32 neural scores. Full photo/real/GFX review remains required.

native_visual_review.interpretation: The original and replay controls look close, with no consistent native photographic advantage. Fine fabric strands remain largely lost, foliage waxy and fence wires soft. Neural fence geometry is more coherent than channel-RawNIND's colored grid. Analytic carriers remain attenuated, although the replay's 16 px response is stronger numerically. Fixed 8-bit flats show no obvious new structure, without excluding small residual errors. GFX ISO100 differs optically and in time and is not exact GT.

decision: No new recipe or model promotion. Identical-source/same-seed replay produces different restoration weights and mixed quality changes; observed photo/known/procedural mean losses demonstrate procedural nonrepeatability at this configuration. One replay does not estimate training-seed variance or isolate a numerical cause. Keep V43 step2000 reference; finish original fresh no-context/S/B10000 schedules with full-state/source/runtime guards. No convergence, SOTA or speed-target claim.
